entries.title: Matthew 18:1
segments: At that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who is the greater in the kingdom of Heaven?

entries.title: Matthew 18:2
segments: And Jesus called a little child to Him and set him in their midst,

entries.title: Matthew 18:3
segments: and said, Truly I say to you, Unless you are converted and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:4
segments: Therefore whoever shall humble himself like this little child, this one is the greater in the kingdom of Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:5
segments: And whoever shall receive one such little child in My name receives Me.

entries.title: Matthew 18:6
segments: But whoever shall offend one of these little [ones] who believes in Me, it would be better for him that an ass's millstone were hung around his neck, and he be sunk in the depth of the sea.

entries.title: Matthew 18:7
segments: Woe to the world because of offenses! For it is necessary that offenses come; but woe to that man by whom the offense comes!

entries.title: Matthew 18:8
segments: And if your hand or your foot causes you to offend, cut them off and throw [them] from you. It is better for you to enter into life lame or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

entries.title: Matthew 18:9
segments: And if your eye offends you, pluck it out and throw [it] from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire.

entries.title: Matthew 18:10
segments: Take heed [that] you do not despise one of these little [ones]. For I say to you that in Heaven their angels always behold the face of My Father in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:11
segments: For the Son of man has come to save that which was lost.

entries.title: Matthew 18:12
segments: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them strays, does he not leave the ninety and nine [and] go into the mountains and seek the straying one?

entries.title: Matthew 18:13
segments: And if it happens that he finds it, truly I say to you, he rejoices more over it than over the ninety and nine which did not stray.

entries.title: Matthew 18:14
segments: Even so it is not [the] will of your Father in Heaven that one of these little [ones] should perish.

entries.title: Matthew 18:15
segments: But if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone. If he hears you, you have gained your brother.

entries.title: Matthew 18:16
segments: But if he will not hear [you], take one or two more with you, so that in [the] mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

entries.title: Matthew 18:17
segments: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell [it] to the church. But if he neglects to hear the church, let him be to you as a heathen and a tax-collector.

entries.title: Matthew 18:18
segments: Truly I say to you, Whatever you shall bind on earth shall occur, having been bound in Heaven; and whatever you shall loose on earth shall occur, having been loosed in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:19
segments: Again I say to you that if two of you shall agree on earth as regarding anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them by My Father in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:20
segments: For where two or three are gathered together in My name, there I am in their midst.

entries.title: Matthew 18:21
segments: Then Peter came to Him and said, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me and I forgive him? Until seven times?

entries.title: Matthew 18:22
segments: Jesus said to him, I do not say to you, Until seven times; but, Until seventy times seven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:23
segments: Therefore the kingdom of Heaven has been compared to a certain king who desired to make an accounting with his servants.

entries.title: Matthew 18:24
segments: And when he had begun to count, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

entries.title: Matthew 18:25
segments: But as he had nothing to pay, his lord commanded that he, and his wife and children, and all that he had, be sold, and payment be made.

entries.title: Matthew 18:26
segments: Then the servant fell down and worshiped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me and I will pay you all.

entries.title: Matthew 18:27
segments: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion and released him and forgave him the debt.

entries.title: Matthew 18:28
segments: But the same servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. And he laid hands on him and took [him] by the throat, saying, Pay me what you owe.

entries.title: Matthew 18:29
segments: And his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, Have patience with me and I will pay you all.

entries.title: Matthew 18:30
segments: And he would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay the debt.

entries.title: Matthew 18:31
segments: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were very sorry. And they came and told their lord all that was done.

entries.title: Matthew 18:32
segments: Then his lord, after he had called him, said to him, O wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

entries.title: Matthew 18:33
segments: Should you not also have pitied your fellow servant, even as I had pity on you?

entries.title: Matthew 18:34
segments: And his lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

entries.title: Matthew 18:35
segments: So likewise shall My heavenly Father do also to you, unless each one of you from your hearts forgive his brother their trespasses.
